root_cause: D-split serialization: 16 sequential BD_HALF=32 passes per K-tile, each requiring 4 threadgroup barriers. Compute-bound at 36% ALU utilization vs SDPA's 38%. The 8% gap is the overhead of serial D-half processing.
conclusion: D=512 on M1/M2 is limited to 0.80x SDPA with D-split architecture. Breaking 1.0x requires either M3+ hardware or a fundamentally different kernel design (e.g., Apple's SDPA-internal fused approach).
